title: After 8 months of development, my Castlevania: Harmony of Despair-inspired game is finally on Steam!
author: kmrodrigo
selftext:
I know Harmony of Despair isn't the most beloved Castlevania, but it holds a special place in my heart.

I still remember spending countless hours on the couch with my younger brother, playing it on our PS3. Those are some of my favorite gaming memories.

That's what inspired me to start building **Kingsbane** 8 months ago.

I'm planning to release a **playable demo later this year, featuring local multiplayer and Steam Remote Play Together**, so you'll be able to invite a friend to play online even if they don't own the game!

Here's a gameplay preview. I'd love to hear your thoughts!

**If you like what you see, please wishlist Kingsbane on Steam.** It makes a huge difference for a small indie project!

🎮 **Steam:** [https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350570/Kingsbane/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/3350570/Kingsbane/)
